acceptance_conditions: The typed candidate builder rejects tagged Starfall after the neutral opener exception when native signed Eclipse power is >= -70 without Lunar Eclipse aura.

Focused source/SQL tests, the rotation-review suite, and the frozen WoWSims reference catalog checks pass; native candidate visibility, exact-300 validation, performance, and raid acceptance remain open.

The implementation changes only a Balance Starfall tag/migration, the shared typed candidate predicate, and source-shape tests; it does not write Eclipse power or modify the resolver's existing Eclipse-direction rules.

acceptance_claim: The bounded source/config/test implementation is complete and the required deterministic checks passed. This does not claim native candidate-mask visibility, live exact-300 behavior, actor performance acceptance, raid clear, or parent-objective completion.

evidence_excerpts.excerpt: The plan binds one Balance-only Starfall lunar-window predicate to the reviewed native baseline and forbids stat, coefficient, roster, encounter, route, and denominator changes.

The exact run proves five native Starfall casts versus 3.001 WoWSims casts and identifies the missing post-opener lunar-window predicate while retaining candidate-mask visibility as an evidence limit.
The native Eclipse aura lifecycle removes Lunar at nonnegative POWER_ECLIPSE and Solar at nonpositive POWER_ECLIPSE.
POWER_ECLIPSE has native minimum -100 and is therefore a signed bar.
The exact reference Starfall branches use currentLunarEnergy > 70 early and >= 100 thereafter.
The accepted native event mix contains Starfall at 5700 ms and then roughly every 60 seconds, with no movement or submission-failure signal.
